findings.finding: Availability, computability, assurance, eligibility and authority are separate in code, schema and registry.
Required, optional, warning-only, alternative and prohibited dependencies have exact selective behavior and visible identities.
Optional and warning dependencies do not suppress raw components; required failure affects only declared dependents.
Not requested, not applicable, not computable, censored and conflicted outcomes remain distinct.
Consumer evaluation is exact-policy, inactive, noncanonical, authority-sensitive and contains no numeric staleness threshold.
Denominator records expose complete terminal-disposition counts and all required accounting identities.
Transition rates use transition-pair units and mixed-unit denominators fail closed.
Overlap reports preserve raw units, require exact claim and policy identities, and select no weighting, deduplication or numeric adjustment.
Population comparisons fail closed on unit, scope, release, clock, dependency, consumer, denominator, overlap or censorship-policy mismatch.
Legacy QUALITY is represented only as a transparent non-governing crosswalk and projection.
Outcome, Validation and reserved authority fields are prohibited from technical inputs.
No market data, external artifact, R2 write, active selector or downstream activation is present.

rollback: Disable or remove the inactive WP9 shadow package while retaining contracts, fixtures, QA and CEAR-G9. Active C2 remains unchanged.
